responseMessageContents.text:
That's a great infographic! It visually communicates the altitude-oxygen relationship really well — the color gradient from green to red as elevation increases is intuitive, and the labeled zones with symptoms at each level would complement your O2 equivalent page nicely.

It could work as a reference image or educational visual that users can view alongside the calculated O2 data. Want me to add it to the O2 equivalent page? I could place it as a tappable/expandable image, or as a section within the page.
